newsitem.title: IRAN: No survivors in Iran military plane crash - agency.
newsitem.headline: No survivors in Iran military plane crash - agency.

text.p: There were no survivors when an Iranian military plane with about 8O people on board crashed in a mountainous region in northeastern Iran, the official news agency IRNA said on Friday.

It quoted an aviation official as saying there were no survivors among the passengers and crew of the C-130 Hercules transport plane which crashed on Thursday. The victims were military personnel and their family members, the official added.
